description: Legal consultation platform with AI assistance

authenticated_any.description: Any logged-in user (client, lawyer, or admin)

endpoints.description: Register new user (client or lawyer)
Login and get JWT token
Logout and blacklist token
Request password reset
Verify reset token validity (query: token)
Reset password with token
Get current user full profile (user + client/lawyer details)
Update basic profile fields (city, region)
Upload profile picture
Delete profile picture
Delete account with full cascade cleanup

chat.description: AI chat assistant for legal guidance

endpoints.description: Create new AI chat session
Send message to AI chatbot (saves message, calls AI, saves response)
Get all messages in a chat session
Extract legal specialty from chat and trigger recommendations
Delete chat session and all messages
Check and update expired subscriptions
Get lawyer recommendations for a chat session
Get all AI recommendations for the current client
Update lawyer profile (first_name, last_name, firm, license_number, specialties, languages, hourly_rate, city, region)
Get all reviews received by the lawyer
Get lawyer's reservations (query: status, date_from, date_to, limit)
Update reservation status (accept/reject/complete/cancel) or date/notes
Get payment history with filters (query: date_from, date_to, payment_type)
Create Stripe PaymentIntent for monthly subscription ($299)
Create Stripe PaymentIntent for profile boost (query: boost_level=1-5, price=$49*level)
Get payment transaction history
Get current subscription status (active/expired/cancelled)
Create PaymentIntent for subscription renewal
Cancel active subscription
TEST ONLY: simulate successful payment (query: transaction_id, payment_type)
Stripe webhook handler for payment events

reservation.description: Appointment booking between clients and lawyers

endpoints.description: Create a new reservation with a lawyer (checks availability and active subscription)
List own reservations filtered by role (query: status, limit)
Get single reservation (only if user is the client or lawyer on it)
Update reservation (clients: cancel pending; lawyers: accept/reject/complete, change dates)
Cancel a pending reservation (soft delete)

review.description: Client reviews and ratings for lawyers

endpoints.description: Submit review for a completed reservation (auto-updates lawyer rating)
Get all reviews for a specific lawyer (public)
Get all reviews written by the current client
Get review by reservation ID (only if user is the client or lawyer involved)
Update own review (within 7-day window, recalculates lawyer rating)
Delete own review (within 7-day window, recalculates lawyer rating)
Get all reviews across the platform (query: limit, max 100)
Get platform statistics (total users, clients, lawyers, reservations, reviews, avg rating)
List all users (query: role, is_active, limit)
Get user details by ID
Create a new user (client or lawyer, cannot create admin)
Update user (email, city, region; role changes blocked)
Delete user (query: permanent=true for cascade delete; soft delete not yet implemented)
List all reservations across platform (query: status, limit)
List all lawyers with subscription status (query: is_active, limit)
Activate or deactivate a lawyer (query: is_active=true/false)
